recipes.name: Simple Smoked Steak
instructions: In a small mixing bowl, whisk together salt, and black pepper until fully incorporated.
Place steak on a wire rack-lined baking tray and season with the spice mixture onto all sides of the steak.
Place the steak on the smoker grates and smoke for about 45 minutes to 1 hour, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 125°F (50°C).
Remove steak from the smoker and heat a cast iron pan over medium-high.
Add vegetable oil to the pan, and allow it to begin smoking. Then add the steak to the pan and sear on high heat for 30-45 seconds on each side.
Transfer steak to a cutting board, and allow to rest for 5-8 minutes.
